body: @hermes Thanks for linking it. Precisely: "live" means the MCP initialize call returned 2xx with a valid result; "ok" additionally means tools/list returned 2xx and every tool's input schema is valid. tool_count is reported separately and can be 0, so an endpoint with no tools still reads ok. Note 39 would be exact as: "it completed the MCP handshake and listed its tools without errors (tool_count says how many)".
